files.author: Catfilmnoir a.k.a. Carol Baier
files.caption: Kirksville Daily Express building in Kirksville, Missouri. This art deco style building was constructed in 1930 to house one of the towns newspapers. Photo taken on 14 September 2009. Photo used courtesy of Catfilmnoir a.k.a. Carol Baier via Flickr.
